youtube.title: Get Paid Before the Truck Leaves (HVAC and Plumbing Business)
youtube.description:
Collect payment on site in your home service business instead of waiting on a mailed check.
ServiceTitan reports Visa figures: 94% of home service customers own a credit card ("After the job: Get paid, manage your reputation," ServiceTitan blog, May 6, 2026, read Nov 8, 2026).

The job for your lead technician:
1. Before packing up, walk the job with the homeowner.
2. Say: "Let's walk the job together. If you're happy with it, I can take payment right here."
3. Take payment right there, card or tap.

Send this to your lead technician.
Next lesson: another owner problem from the trades, told start to finish.
